themes.label: Feature Gaps & Trading Tools
themes.description: Traders express dissatisfaction with the lack of advanced technical indicators, chart-based trading capabilities, and specific order types (like VTT or trailing stop-loss) compared to competitor platforms.

quotes.text: 1. SmartExit needs an automatic Trailing Stop Loss Option! Please check Fyers for inspiration! 2. Charts loading in mobile app get stuck frequently, any reason or fix to it? 3. Independent CPR indicator and Previous Day High and Previous Day Low, Previous Day Close marking indicator are required. Again, please check Fyers for inspiration!

I'm talking about Trade directly from charts i.e., like Dhan you can simply drag drop SL and target levels. The feature is there in Groww web but it is not available in mobile. i usually trade from mobile so if they roll out this important feature I'll come back and give it a 5 Even Zerodha kite has that feature now
One thing to suggest is that please add all indicators which are available in the trading view. or give access to the punch order directly from the trading view.

themes.label: UI/UX & Navigation Issues
themes.description: Reviews highlight problems with the user interface, such as disappearing back buttons, confusing navigation after updates, and the absence of specific data displays like absolute P/L figures.

quotes.text: When we open the charts the back button on our phone just disappears and we end up clicking the scalper mode or a different chart when not needed. Also the limit order is auto filled every time we click. so annoying to modify.

1. Scalper button placement is terrible; whenever I hit back from a chart, it accidentally triggers scalping. Not everyone is a scalper! Give an option to hide it. 2. Severe chart lag: switching charts still shows the old asset first. I have to go back and reload it twice just to refresh. 3. Web version is too complicated and confusing for investing.
e.g. the scalper button you have added near buy/sell, asked whether user need that button or not and also stop forcing groww charts. both are irritating while trading.

themes.label: Customer Support & Responsiveness
themes.description: Many users cite poor customer service experiences, including unreachable support teams, unresolved account issues, and unhelpful responses to critical trading or account errors.

quotes.text: customer support is very good also during market hours
Customer care is not easy to reach nor is able to solve the issues properly.
I've attempted to contact them through both messages and calls, but all interactions are automated with no genuine human connection or assistance.

themes.label: App Performance & Stability
themes.description: Users frequently report issues with app lag, buffering, freezing, and crashes, particularly during high market volatility or when accessing charts and trading features.

quotes.text: sometimes it lags or just keeps buffering when markets are at high volatility so it should be improved and now I'm changing my rating because there IPO and f&O pages keep stucking and showing wrong information.
The stability and usability of app is decreasing on each update. Last session I could see some stocks listed twice in All stocks section.
from yesterday the App start working slow and I thought it was my device but even if I cleared up the space for it there was still hanging and I almost lost from my trading

themes.label: Order Execution & Reliability
themes.description: Users report critical failures in order execution, including orders not triggering at set prices, auto-filling errors, and delays in notifications that impact trading decisions.

quotes.text: Your app gets stuck far too often at the time of trade execution, and even after setting a profit/loss limit, the order does not get executed automatically.
The app is super user-friendly with fast order execution.
order placing gets stuck. many times loss booked due to platform inconvenience.
